articles.title: Contacting Contoso Home
articles.text: Our support team replies seven days a week by email, chat, and the web form, and we read every message, including the kind ones.

articles.title: Delivery times and shipping regions
articles.text: Standard delivery takes 3 to 5 business days within the continental United States. We currently ship to United States addresses only.

articles.title: Tracking an order
articles.text: You can track any order at contoso-home.example/orders with your order number. Tracking updates within 24 hours of dispatch. If a parcel shows delivered but has not arrived, we open a carrier trace and reply within 2 business days.

articles.title: Changing or cancelling an order
articles.text: Orders can be changed or cancelled until they are packed, usually within 2 hours of purchase. After that, you can return the item free of charge once it arrives.

articles.title: Returns and exchanges
articles.text: You can return or exchange most items within 30 days of delivery. If an item arrived damaged or we sent the wrong item, we collect it free of charge and send a replacement or refund.

articles.title: Refund timing
articles.text: Refunds reach your original payment method 5 to 7 business days after we receive the returned item.

articles.title: Duplicate or unexpected charges
articles.text: A second charge is usually a temporary card authorization that drops off within 3 to 5 business days. If it is still there after that, we refund it straight away.

articles.title: Payment methods and promo codes
articles.text: We accept major credit and debit cards and PayPal. Promo codes apply at checkout; if a valid code did not apply, we refund the difference within 7 days of purchase.

articles.title: Invoices and tax receipts
articles.text: Invoices and tax receipts for every order are available to download under Your orders.

articles.title: Updating payment details
articles.text: You can update your card under Your account, then Payment methods. For your security, please never send card numbers by email or chat.

articles.title: Product materials and dimensions
articles.text: Each product page lists materials, finish, and dimensions. Our oak range uses solid oak tops with oak-veneered legs.

articles.title: Furniture warranty
articles.text: All furniture carries a one-year warranty against manufacturing defects. Send a photo of the defect and your order number and we arrange a repair or replacement.

articles.title: Missing parts and assembly
articles.text: We ship missing parts free within 3 business days. Assembly guides for every product are at contoso-home.example/assembly.

articles.title: Sign-in and password reset
articles.text: Password reset emails can take up to 10 minutes and sometimes land in spam. Reset links expire after one hour.

articles.title: Website and app errors
articles.text: If checkout or the app shows an error, try refreshing or another browser. Our team logs every reported error and follows up when it is fixed.

articles.title: Service complaints
articles.text: We are sorry when we fall short. A customer care lead reviews every complaint within one business day.

articles.title: Agent refund approval limit
articles.text: INTERNAL: agents may approve refunds up to $200. Refunds above $200 need a team lead.

articles.title: Chargebacks, legal threats, and safety reports
articles.text: INTERNAL: chargebacks, legal threats, and injury or safety reports go to the customer care lead. Do not discuss liability.

articles.title: Privacy requests
articles.text: INTERNAL: requests to delete an account or personal data go to the privacy team and must be verified first.
